question: Which 3.1.28 entry pushes an application page, and does it open the Manager page from the Supervisor?
prototype_hypothesis: The page push is goto_page_no_check_stacktop (0xc4e0208), not pagemanager show_app (0xc44d504); the key is the u32 at page descriptor +20 = page_id | app_id << 16.
callsite_evidence: The body at 0xc4e0208 carries the log tag "goto_page_no_check_stacktop": it resolves the key with 0xc44c290, which walks the registered-page list at 0x2008144c comparing the u32 at page+20, pauses the current page, runs the transition and the enter callback.

The ported 0xc44d504 is pagemanager show_app: it does an app prelaunch check and logs "show_app: page == NULL" for both an app id (0xCA) and (app<<8)|page (0xCA00); calling it from a watchface callback or an LVGL timer kills the UI.

Calling 0xc4e0209 with (0xCA << 16) | 0 from an LVGL timer opens the registered Manager page: the device log shows "insert_app_to_list: insert app to list pkg = com.canopus.manager", "on_ui_create: create view 0x3c34f1a8:{202, 0}", the in/out animation callbacks, and {202, 0} resume/pause on screen wake and sleep.
The page becomes active but renders black on this emulator run, so the Manager UI backend is not yet drawing on v8.
control_flow_evidence: CANOPUS_CMD_OPEN_MANAGER -> platform open_manager -> canopus_manager_native_open -> page_goto((APP_ID << 16) | page, 0, 0, 0), issued from an LVGL timer tick on the watchface.
ownership_analysis: No new ownership: the page descriptors stay owned by the Supervisor; the page manager keeps them in its own registry.
unsafe_assumptions: Emulator evidence only; no physical device has run this.
The page key layout is read from the exact image (page descriptor +20), not from a live symbol table.
recommended_probe: Make the v8 Manager page render (widgets are created but the page shows black), then open it again and confirm the UI.
